verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of gating reader-facing docs behind a password, JWT, or SSO. The only authentication items are adjacent: SSO sign-in for Teammates, admin and editor access controls, and 2FA on ReadMe accounts. None of these restricts which customers can view published content.

support.subject: As a DevRel lead, I gate some or all docs behind authentication — password, JWT, or SSO — for customers-only content
